decisions.quote: This study replicated the genetic association of SNP of FTO (rs17817449) with obesity in a north Indian population and, to the authors' knowledge; this is the first such association study in a north Indian population.
decisions.reason: The available complete primary abstract specifies rs17817449 association and a new north-Indian sample but names no earlier original. Dina2007 is compatible with this discovery context; multiple early FTO reports concern associated intron1 variants. Original publisher/primary abstracts establish plausibility, not which particular earlier report the authors retested. Full replicating text was unavailable after the documented acquisition routes. The exact original identity remains an actual evidence-access limit; no additional genuinely absent paper can be certified and no categorical represented exclusion is forced.
